summary: OpenAI announced an agreement to secure approximately 8 gigawatts-IT of data center capacity at the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Ohio, developed with SB Energy, NVIDIA and the U.S. Department of Energy, including a $1.5 billion NVIDIA investment in SB Energy and community funding commitments.

mechanisms.reason: OpenAI is securing multi-gigawatt data center power capacity, directly converting into new grid and generation demand.
mechanisms.quote: OpenAI has entered into an agreement to secure approximately 8 gigawatts-IT at the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio, working with SB Energy, NVIDIA, and the U.S. Department of Energy.

mechanisms.reason: NVIDIA is committing capital and credit support to build out the data center campus alongside OpenAI's capacity lease.
mechanisms.quote: NVIDIA will invest $1.5 billion in SB Energy and will provide credit support for the land, power, and shell buildout associated with the initial 4.25 IT-GW.

mechanisms.reason: OpenAI states the capacity is contracted for projected frontier training needs as well as product demand growth.
mechanisms.quote: We are contracting for this capacity based on our projected long-term needs for frontier training and growing demand for our products.

mechanisms.reason: OpenAI states it will fund the lease commitments partly through capital raised from investors, tying this build-out to its ongoing capital access.
mechanisms.quote: OpenAI will begin paying only as completed capacity becomes available for lease and will fund those commitments through revenue and cash flow from the significant growth of our business and capital raised from investors.

categories.reason: SB Energy builds, owns and operates the data center and leases capacity to OpenAI as the customer, a neocloud-style hosting arrangement.
categories.quote: SB Energy will build, own, and operate the data center under a 20-year lease to OpenAI and deliver capacity over time.

categories.reason: The campus will exclusively host NVIDIA AI compute infrastructure, directly transmitting demand to that accelerator maker.
categories.quote: which will exclusively host NVIDIA AI compute infrastructure

notable_reason: An 8 gigawatt-IT data center commitment with a $1.5 billion NVIDIA capital investment is a large, concrete infrastructure build-out that a sector-tracking reader would want to see today.
